comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
The conditions to obtain this title is:
1) Maritime level 80.
2) 360.000 Battle Fame.
3) 100 Ganador Missions Succeed.

This title reduces the critical shots by NPC which is by 30 % at Stern and by 60 % at Bow. Your apprentice can benefit this title too during the battle.
